sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Can Multiparametric Digital Whole-Slide Image Analysis Improve Recurrence Risk Stratification in Oral Tongue Squamous Cell Carcinoma?》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Repeated five-fold cross-validation yielded a cross-fitted consensus concordance index of 0.587 (mean per-repetition concordance index 0.567 ± 0.039), compared with an apparent concordance index of 0.676, with no evidence of a difference from conventional prognostic factors.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】In exploratory multivariable Firth-penalized Cox regression adjusted for pT3-pT4a category, the favorable group showed a lower recurrence hazard than the poor group (HR 0.104, 95% CI 0.001-0.854, p = 0.0316); this non-cross-validated estimate is fragile given the small favorable group without recurrence events.

evidence.text: Repeated five-fold cross-validation yielded a cross-fitted consensus concordance index of 0.587 (mean per-repetition concordance index 0.567 ± 0.039), compared with an apparent concordance index of 0.676, with no evidence of a difference from conventional prognostic factors.

In exploratory multivariable Firth-penalized Cox regression adjusted for pT3-pT4a category, the favorable group showed a lower recurrence hazard than the poor group (HR 0.104, 95% CI 0.001-0.854, p = 0.0316); this non-cross-validated estimate is fragile given the small favorable group without recurrence events.
